details.further_information: The reported transfer fee for the move from Adelaide United to FC Bayern varies between €750,000 and €3.4 million, depending on the source. Adelaide United announced that the sale of Irankunda was a new record transfer (previous record transfer: €1.5 million). His parents are from Burundi.
